d: Jet black hair is styled with blunt bangs and a high, voluminous bun, with two long, straight strands framing the face and a single long ponytail trailing behind. The gold-amber eyes are large and rounded with a gentle expression, set on a youthful face with the maturity of a young adolescent. A slender build is dressed in a white and teal traditional-inspired garment with a high black collar and red decorative ties, paired with a grey utility belt adorned with metallic buckles. Signature details include a small white floral hair clip and a thin black choker.
